import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def pw(x, y, p):
    a = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            a = a * x % p
        x = x * x % p
        y >>= 1
    return a

def dfs(k, n, b, x, g, p, b_array):
    if b_array[n] < k:
        return 0
    if k == 1:
        return g[n]
    if x[k][n]:
        return x[k][n]
    t = 0
    i = n & (n - 1)
    while i != 0:
        if b_array[i] >= k - 1:
            x[k][n] += dfs(k - 1, i, b, x, g, p, b_array) * g[n ^ i]
            t += 1
            if t == 18:
                t = 0
                x[k][n] %= p
        i = i & (i - 1)
    x[k][n] %= p
    return x[k][n]

def main():
    data = list(map(int, input().split()))
    n, k, p = data[0], data[1], data[2]
    b_array = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        b_array[i] = b_array[i >> 1] + (i & 1)
    b = b_array
    a = pw(k, n, p)
    if n & 1:
        print(a)
        return
    l = min(k, b[n])
    f = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        f[i] = f[i - 1] * i % p
    g = [0] * (n + 1)
    g[n] = pw(f[n], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(n, 0, -1):
        g[i - 1] = g[i] * i % p
    x = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    d = 0
    for i in range(l, 0, -1):
        c = 1
        for j in range(i + 1):
            c = c * (k - j) % p
            c = c * pw(j + 1, p - 2, p) % p
        d += c * dfs(i, n, b, x, g, p, b_array)
    a = (a - d * f[n] % p + p) % p
    print(a)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
